source.note: Base profile transcribed from the source. Faction rules are summaries.

specialRules.name: Space Marine crew
specialRules.description: Boarding rolls gain +2; outgoing hit-and-run rolls gain +1 and incoming hit-and-run rolls suffer −1. Generate leadership as 8, 9 or 10 on D6 results 1–2, 3–4 or 5–6 respectively.

specialRules.name: Boarding torpedoes
specialRules.description: Torpedo tubes may launch boarding torpedoes as well as ordinary torpedoes.

specialRules.name: Thunderhawks
specialRules.description: Gunships act as fighters and assault boats, with 4+ resilience. See the faction rules for interception limits and Crusade fleet ordnance.

specialRules.name: Quadrants — manual tracking required
specialRules.description: The 12 hits, 4 shields and 4 turrets are per quadrant. Track the four quadrants separately in notes; the single hull tracker does not represent the whole fortress. Quadrant batteries, lances and launch bays repeat per quadrant; all-round weapons are central. Consult the fortress and Ramilies rules.
